title: Empirical use needs a process theory

statements.text: The principle does not by itself say how neurons or synapses implement inference. Applying it empirically requires committing to a particular process theory, such as predictive coding or belief propagation on a given generative model.

sources.quote: Empirical applications of the free-energy principle are not straightforward because they entail a commitment to a particular process theory, especially at the cellular and synaptic levels.
